visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard, wearing a beige cap, a grey work jumpsuit, and a silver chain, stands in a studio setting. Behind him are several large ceramic toilet bowls in white and beige. He holds a piece of white toilet paper toward the camera. (2) Close-up shots show the toilet paper being torn, revealing fine fibers at the edges. The lighting is bright and even. (3) In a laboratory-like setting, a hand stirs torn toilet paper in a glass beaker filled with water using a metal rod. The paper quickly breaks down into small particles. (4) A rapid montage displays various items: green packs of wet wipes, white lace stockings, sanitary pads, gold-packaged condoms, colorful plastic building blocks, and a pile of cigarette butts in an ashtray. (5) The host stands in front of a giant scale model of a toilet bowl, gesturing broadly with his arms. (6) A top-down shot shows water and toilet paper flushing down a real toilet bowl. (7) A close-up of the host's hand shows him crumbling a roll of toilet paper. (8) Transition to a new scene where the host is working in a darker, more cluttered environment resembling a plumbing or construction site, holding a hammer and gesturing near pipes. (9) The video ends with a logo of a green leaf and blue water icon against a black background with formal white text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM starts. A male voice delivers energetic speech with high articulation. A crisp 'whoosh' SFX signals a scene transition. (2) Paper rustling and tearing sounds are heard during close-up visual phases. The speaker maintains a pedagogical yet fast-paced rhythm. (3) A soft splashing and stirring sound is audible as the paper dissolves in water. Multiple sharp 'pop' and 'hit' sound effects are synchronized with fast-cut visual overlays. (4) During the montage of prohibited items, rapid percussive 'ding' sounds accent each list item. The speaker's pitch rises at the end of phrases. (5) A resonant 'toilet flush' SFX dominates the mix briefly, followed by a continuation of the synth-based BGM. (6) A short audio clip from a film follows, characterized by different acoustic resonance and background metallic clanging. (7) The BGM fades into a clean, short three-note logo jingle at the conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Myth Debunking -> Scientific Demonstration -> List of Forbidden Items -> Hygiene Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is an official public service announcement produced by the Ministry of Environment in Taiwan. It utilizes an energetic host and fast-paced editing to educate citizens that modern toilet paper is water-soluble and should be flushed to improve hygiene, while strictly warning against flushing non-soluble household waste like wet wipes and sanitary products.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Display of the official Ministry of Environment logo and a direct promotion of government waste management policy.
